hero.title: Arranged by people who live here
hero.lede: PrathibaLanka is a small Sri Lankan travel house. We build private journeys for travellers who would rather see four places properly than fourteen badly.

story.heading: Fewer places. Longer looks.
story.lede: We started with one vehicle and a list of places we loved. That has not really changed: we still plan every journey by hand, and we still send people to the guesthouses we would send our own families to.

points.title: One consultant per journey
points.text: The person who plans your trip is the person who answers when you write.

points.title: On the ground, always
points.text: A local number that is answered day or night, for the whole of your stay.

values.heading: Four things we do not compromise on

items.title: Local knowledge, not a script
items.text: Our guides grew up with these roads, temples and tea estates. They will tell you when to go, and when not to.

items.title: Private by default
items.text: No shared coaches, no strangers at breakfast. Your vehicle, your guide, your pace.

items.title: Priced in the open
items.text: One figure per person, agreed before you travel. No commission stops, no surprise extras.

items.title: Care for the island
items.text: Family-run stays, plastic-free journeys and wildlife viewed at a respectful distance.

items.title: A single vehicle in Colombo
items.text: Two guides, one van and a notebook of favourite guesthouses along the south coast.

items.title: The hill country routes
items.text: We mapped the tea line properly - which carriage, which side, which stops are worth the walk.

items.title: Wildlife done quietly
items.text: Long relationships with park trackers, and a firm rule about keeping our distance.

items.title: A small team, still on the road
items.text: We keep the number of journeys per season low enough that every traveller gets a real consultant.
